findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: memory_recall, work_comment_list, file_upload_request · Private data: mcp_auth, version, memory_soul_get, memory_soul_set, memory_assemble_context, memory_session_ensure, memory_skill_resolve, memory_graph_relate, memory_state_get, memory_state_set, file_create, file_upload_request, file_update, file_get, file_list, file_publish, file_unpublish, file_archive, file_version_delete · Public sink: mcp_auth, project_status_post, work_follower_add, work_follower_remove, file_create, file_upload_request, file_publish, file_unpublish · Destructive: mcp_auth, memory_forget_procedure, memory_forget_skill, work_remove_from_project, work_dependency_remove, work_follower_remove, memory_ontology_merge_entities, memory_action_apply, memory_forget, file_upload_request, file_version_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: memory_recall, work_comment_list, file_upload_request · Private data: mcp_auth, version, memory_soul_get, memory_soul_set, memory_assemble_context, memory_session_ensure, memory_skill_resolve, memory_graph_relate, memory_state_get, memory_state_set, file_create, file_upload_request, file_update, file_get, file_list, file_publish, file_unpublish, file_archive, file_version_delete · Public sink: mcp_auth, project_status_post, work_follower_add, work_follower_remove, file_create, file_upload_request, file_publish, file_unpublish · Destructive: mcp_auth, memory_forget_procedure, memory_forget_skill, work_remove_from_project, work_dependency_remove, work_follower_remove, memory_ontology_merge_entities, memory_action_apply, memory_forget, file_upload_request, file_version_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
